findings.evidence: docs/managed-rollout.md:108 says adding the runner answers before rollout is sufficient. However, design.md identifies the existing edit as `runs-on: alters`, while template/.github/workflows/dev-platform.yml.jinja:26 now renders `runs-on: "alters"`. Copier reapplies the downstream patch from the old `ubuntu-latest` baseline onto the new rendering; the unquoted customization conflicts with the quoted target. scripts/rollout_project.py:1413–1431 refuses recovery because the customized workflow differs from its old template baseline. The migration test at tests/test_ci_runner_selection.py:227–235 only adds answers and never makes the existing workflow hand edit, so it misses this failure. The stated adoption path therefore still blocks the motivating project.
findings.summary: The documented migration does not unblock the existing hand-edited self-hosted workflow.
